name: critique-review
context_rationale: The skill orchestrates from the main agent thread — reads existing critique.json and slice artifacts, invokes the meta-Critic subagent, runs a structural audit, and hands control back to /critique Step 4.5 TRI-1 which requires the main thread's user-input gate.
summary: Dual review (DR-1) of the first Critic's output for per-slice false positives, false negatives, and severity miscalibrations. Spawns a 'critique-review' subagent that independently re-applies the 8 review dimensions against mission-brief, design, and the first Critic's critique.json. After receiving the meta-Critic's output, runs critique_review_audit to validate structure, then hands findings back to /critique Step 4.5 TRI-1 for user reconciliation. Recommended for high-tier and auth/data-model/contract slices; optional for low-tier slices.

reads.purpose: Slice intent and ACs handed to meta-Critic
Slice design handed to meta-Critic for independent re-review
First Critic's findings — primary input for the meta-Critic
New ADRs from this slice handed to meta-Critic

outputs.purpose: Meta-Critic findings: VALID/SUSPICIOUS/SEVERITY-WRONG per finding plus missed findings

agents.name: critique-review
agents.when: Step 2, after gathering slice context including the first Critic's critique.md
agents.purpose: Meta-Critic review of the first Critic's findings for VALID/SUSPICIOUS/SEVERITY-WRONG classifications and missed findings

tools.name: project_frame_synth
tools.purpose: Synthesizes project frame so the meta-Critic can re-check the first Critic's review against strategic direction (PFS-1/ADR-080)

tools.name: critique_review_audit
tools.purpose: Validates critique-review.md structure: 4 required sections, dual-review verdict in {ACCEPT,ADJUST,EXTEND}, Reviewed-by and Date fields

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Read mission-brief.json, design.json, critique.json, ADRs, triage.json, milestone.json

harness_tools.name: Write
harness_tools.purpose: Write critique-review.json to the slice folder
